job_hypothesis: Hang a multi-piece wall so precisely the client never questions it
name: Priya Nair
behaviors: Freelance installer for galleries and high-end homes
Uses a laser for layout, then double-checks each piece with a bubble level
values: A client never spots a crooked frame
current_alternatives: A small bubble level on top of each frame as a second check
Tape measure, painter's tape and pencil marks for spacing
Stepping back and trusting a trained eye
objections: Her laser-plus-bubble routine already works, and changing it risks a mistake on a client's wall
Getting one frame level is easy; spacing and matching across 30 pieces is the hard part
A beeping tool in a quiet gallery or a client's living room feels unprofessional
She'd need to see it match her bubble level's precision before trusting it
